candidate_policy.economic_data_admission: admit_development_economic_ledger only; exact historical artifact and exact frozen V2 config required
candidate_policy.next_experiment_status: predeclared; not run; no winner claimed
candidate_policy.selection: deterministic and train-only; all candidates/results retained; OOS untouched until selection is frozen

development_data.admitted_economics_source: frozen V1 historical closed-trade ledger only
development_data.forward_tick_evidence: capture/provenance use only; not admitted for V2 economics

fold_semantics.cross_boundary: censor from that fold; never reassign to a different OOS fold; it may enter later training only after its exit is chronologically available
fold_semantics.rationale: expanding training preserves chronological causality while retaining each validation interval untouched until train-only deterministic selection is frozen
fold_semantics.training: setup originated before validation start AND outcome closed strictly before validation start
fold_semantics.validation: setup originated within the validation interval AND outcome closed strictly before validation end

next_experiment_specification.per_fold_oos_population: selected candidate only; setup origin inside validation interval and exit strictly before validation end
next_experiment_specification.per_fold_training_population: only setup origins before validation start whose exits closed strictly before validation start
next_experiment_specification.permanent_direction_removal: not authorized by one aggregate or by this experiment alone; require cross-fold stability and Sol/main review
next_experiment_specification.report_after_selection_lock: retain every candidate result plus selected-candidate OOS; mark any OOS direction cell below 30 closed trades small-sample
next_experiment_specification.selection_lock: serialize the selected candidate and every training result before opening that fold's OOS metrics

reserved_holdout.economics: prohibited; raw forward capture inventory only
